fundamentalNotes: A 3x move in one year would require roughly a 200 percent gain from the snapshot price.
The observed consensus and high analyst targets are far below a 3x price level.
TSLA estimates have wide dispersion, so the right advisor response is scenario planning, not prediction.
TSLA.advisorConclusion: Available analyst targets in this snapshot do not support a 3x one-year move as a base case. Treat it as a speculative upside scenario and compare it with the client's concentration risk and prior conservative risk profile.
